claim_boundary.earned_if_pass: one host selected by unauthenticated egress preflight supported the frozen deterministic relay and reproduced the observable Temporary Chat exact-canary boundary in two automated paired trials

design_change: Split unauthenticated network-path qualification from the authenticated primary qualification. The selected host must pass egress preflight before any Google login or Gemini trial contact.

pass_requires: page.goto does not raise a network transport error
host fingerprint receipt written before qualification
egress_preflight.selection_rule: Muse may provision candidate Linux hosts, but the first host used for the authenticated primary run must have a PASS preflight receipt. Preflight may be repeated across candidate hosts because it contains no Gemini trial prompt and no user credential material.

each_trial: submit unique canary and require ACK
open second fresh Temporary Chat blind probe
pass_requires: preflight receipt host fingerprint matches current host
Temporary Chat and Extended markers observed before every exposure/blind contact
no login page during primary contacts
prompt SHA256 receipt for every submitted prompt

question: Can a deterministic Gemini browser relay complete the two-trial Temporary Chat qualification when the execution host is selected only after a pre-contact Gemini egress preflight?

successor_if_pass.constraint: use the exact RELAY-002 selected-host and relay contract; one fresh Temporary Chat per arm; same chat retained within each arm; no retries
